ROCm MTP (Multi-Token Prediction) speculative decoding is an inference acceleration technique that leverages AMD's ROCm ecosystem to reduce the latency of Large Language Model (LLM) generation. It operates by using a smaller, faster "draft model" to predict a sequence of $k$ future tokens in parallel. These speculative tokens are then submitted to the larger, more accurate "target model" for verification in a single forward pass.
